# DIMISI Technologies Pvt Ltd
> Engineering the Future of Scalable Software — Autonomous Agents, Cinematic WebGL & Enterprise Digital Systems.

DIMISI Technologies Private Limited is a deep-technology software engineering company headquartered in Kanpur, India. Recognized by the Government of India (DPIIT Certificate DIPP173003, CIN U62013UP2024PTC200921) and a member of the global NVIDIA Inception Program, DIMISI builds enterprise software architectures, autonomous AI agents, computer vision pipelines, and immersive WebGL experiences for clients worldwide.

## Key Facts
- Full Legal Name: DIMISI Technologies Private Limited
- Headquarters: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Website: https://www.dimisi.tech
- Accreditation: NVIDIA Inception Program Member, DPIIT Recognized Startup (Govt. of India)
- Primary Flagship Product: Kalesh (The Unfiltered Social Sphere — https://thekalesh.com)

## Core Engineering Disciplines
- **Autonomous AI & Multi-Agent Systems**: Agentic workflows, custom LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, neural computer vision, and cognitive automation.
- **Cinematic WebGL & Spatial Interfaces**: High-performance 3D web experiences built with Three.js, WebGPU, and custom GLSL shaders running at 60 FPS.
- **Enterprise Software Architecture**: Resilient microservices, cloud-native backend systems (Node.js, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes).
- **Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications**: High-throughput iOS & Android solutions using React Native and Flutter with real-time sync.
- **Data-Driven Digital Platforms & Growth Advisory**: End-to-end product strategy, corporate tech advisory, and scalable SaaS infrastructure.

## Flagship Products
- **Kalesh**: Real-time anonymous public opinion platform with cryptographic zero-knowledge hashing, live polling, and sentiment stream analysis.
- **Karyon**: On-demand verified home services dispatch platform with automated matching and low-latency tracking.
